rca of the issue: Root cause: the honesty_sweep.py script operated only over /app/frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx}. It did not include /app/frontend/public/index.html — but that file contains an inline <script> that builds a per-route META map and invokes addLD() to inject Organization+Product JSON-LD with aggregateRating(reviewCount=12847,ratingValue=4.8) and AggregateOffer(offerCount=500) into the static HTML shell of EVERY route. As a result, even routes whose React pages are 'clean' still emit the banned strings and inflated schema. Secondary cause: 70+ page-level JSON-LD literals were also missed because they aren't ProductSchema callsites — they hand-roll dangerouslySetInnerHTML themselves. Mitigation: (1) extend the sweep to public/index.html (or simply delete the M map and addLD blocks from index.html and let SEOHead drive everything from React), (2) bulk-remove AggregateOffer / aggregateRating literals from src/pages/*.jsx, ideally migrating callers to <ProductSchema verified .../>, (3) drop '500,000+' counters from ConversionElements/NewsletterSignup, (4) drop 'Save €' copy from the 5 F1 GP pages.
